title: Masked AI call forces Parkview High into soft lockdown

reports.title: Parkview High receives 4th AI-generated bomb threat this year
Hoax phone call at Gwinnett high school causes lockdown; campus cleared
Masked AI call forces Parkview High into soft lockdown

summary:
Parkview High School in Gwinnett County, Georgia received its fourth bomb threat of the school year on Monday. The threat was generated using artificial intelligence and came from a masked phone number, matching a pattern seen in earlier incidents. School officials placed the campus on lockdown as a precaution before returning to normal operations. No injuries or explosives were reported. The school district sent a letter to parents about the incident.

Gwinnett County school police are working with the Georgia Bureau of Investigation and the FBI to determine who is responsible. Authorities have not announced any arrests or identified a suspect. The article does not list specific next steps beyond the ongoing investigation, which is focused on tracing the source of the threats.
